x: On a fine afternoon Paul Nihill of Surrey Walking Club, swept into an immediate lead which he steadily increased throughout the whole of the race from John Edgington, the International walker from Coventry and Peter McCullagh of Metropolitan W.C., Oxford University, and Australia.
For some time he had quite a struggle with Met WC's Australian, Peter McCullagh, but the Aussie cracked and retired leaving Ray a solitary leader.
